title: Joe’s Kansas City BBQ Ships Nationwide: How to Order Without the Trip
summary: Joe's Kansas City BBQ, named Nation's Best BBQ by USA Today, ships its legendary ribs, brisket, and burnt ends nationwide on Goldbelly.

## The gas station BBQ joint that became America’s most famous now shipping to your door


Joe’s Kansas City BBQ ships nationwide on Goldbelly. The legendary Kansas City institution, named Nation’s Best BBQ by USA Today in 2015 and featured on Anthony Bourdain’s No Reservations, now delivers its ribs, burnt ends, and brisket anywhere in the United States. The Z-Man Sandwich is worth a trip to Kansas City — everything else ships to your door.


[Order Joe’s Kansas City BBQ on Goldbelly](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/joes-kansas-city-bar-b-que)


## **The Gas Station That Became America’s Best BBQ**


Jeff and Joy Stehney got hooked on barbecue after attending their first competition in 1990. It wasn’t long before they were winning some of the most prestigious competitions in America. They opened Joe’s Kansas City Bar-B-Que in a Kansas City gas station, and the rest is history.


That original gas station location became a destination. The Travel Channel named it the top roadside eatery in the country. Anthony Bourdain featured it on No Reservations. Adam Richman came for Man vs. Food. Andrew Zimmern stopped by for Delicious Destinations. USA Today called it the Nation’s Best BBQ in 2015.


The Stehneys now run three Kansas City restaurants, all synonymous with the best barbecue in a city full of great barbecue.


## **What Makes Joe’s Kansas City BBQ Worth the Hype**


Joe’s is famous for three things: ribs, burnt ends, and the Z-Man Sandwich.


The ribs are pork spare ribs seasoned with a proprietary dry rub, slowly smoked to perfection. USA Today named them the Tastiest Ribs in America. The Daily Meal called them America’s Best in 2014.


The burnt ends and brisket are slow-smoked for 17 hours over Missouri White Oak, the same wood whiskey makers use to age bourbon barrels. Tender, moist, and deeply smoky.


The Z-Man Sandwich is the cult item. Slow-smoked beef brisket or pulled pork, smoked provolone cheese, two crispy onion rings, and Joe’s BBQ sauce on a toasted Kaiser roll. If you’ve heard of Joe’s Kansas City and haven’t had the Z-Man, that’s the thing to know about.


## **What You Can Order on Goldbelly**


Joe’s Kansas City ships a full lineup on Goldbelly. All meats arrive fully cooked, frozen, vacuum-sealed, and packed with dry ice. Thaw in the refrigerator for at least 24 hours before reheating.


- **Ribs, Brisket and Burnt Ends.** The full Joe’s KC experience, serves 4 people.
- **Joe’s KC Ribs 2-Pack.** Two slabs of the USA Today award-winning spare ribs.
- **Joe’s KC Ribs 4-Pack.** Four slabs of spare ribs plus two bottles of Joe’s KC Bar-B-Que Sauce.
- **All The Beef.** Sliced brisket and burnt ends, slow-smoked 17 hours over Missouri White Oak.
- **All The Meat.** About 10 pounds of everything Joe’s serves: spare ribs, pulled pork, beef burnt ends, brisket, sausage, turkey, chicken, and more.
- **Smokie Joe.** Joe’s take on the Sloppy Joe: 3 lbs of smoked brisket and pork in barbecue sauce, plus a bottle of Joe’s sauce.
- **Ribs and Pulled Pork.** Two of Kansas City barbecue’s greatest hits, serves 2 to 4.
- **Whole Smoked Turkey Breast Full Dinner.** For something outside the usual BBQ spread.


You can also add on a Joe’s KC Trucker Hat with any order.


## **How to Order Joe’s Kansas City BBQ Nationwide**


You no longer need to find the gas station on West 47th Street in Kansas City to eat Joe’s. Joe’s Kansas City BBQ ships nationwide on Goldbelly, guaranteed to arrive fresh and packed with dry ice.
